messages.text: Papi just pulled up with the little speaker and a bag of green plantains.
Of course. I was only cutting onions for lunch and now the pot is getting bigger.
He already asked for the Julio Jaramillo one before the rice is even washed lol.
Then grab more cilantro if you pass the store. Rosa might bring two of the Pawtucket cousins too.
Your mom sent me home with that chicken and rice again. My lunch tomorrow is already settled.
She said you ran enough Sunday to earn a container. There is still aji if you want more after practice.
Only if your dad puts those old records on again. The kitchen was louder than the game highlights.
That is how Sunday cooking goes here. Food, music, and everyone walking through the door at once.
Cookout Saturday after the match. I put you down for one plate unless you're bringing somebody.
One plate is right. I'll come straight from Ma's place after I help with groceries.
Good. No repeating last spring where you were checking two calendars before saying yes.
Yeah, that was too much. Saturday is just soccer and food now.
You still coming Saturday or stuck with that sign-in table thing?
Coming after. I have to print flyers first, and I'm trying not to touch the gas card until Friday.
Bro bring the keeper gloves, I'll cover your post-game food. That table better be worth missing warmups.
If families actually show up, it will feel worth the cheap-lunch week.
You free for ten? That email has me pacing around the driveway.
Yeah man. Call after I get this ladder tied down.
Thanks. I may send Lucia the screenshot after, just to see if I'm being dumb.
Do it. She'll cut through the extra drama in two lines.
Jose, si pasas por Market Basket mira si el cilantro esta fresco. El de ayer no servia.
Voy despues de la llamada. Tambien agarro pollo y cebolla?
Si, y aji si tienen. Dejo la olla lista para cuando llegues.
Ok. Guardo el recibo en la bolsa azul como siempre.
Mijo, si vas a contestar ese correo manana, habla con la profe de Bristol primero.
Si, she said she can look at both pay numbers and the job duties after her evening class.
La tienda paga mas, pero tu cara cambia cuando hablas de ayudar a los duenos con papeles y permisos.
I know. I still have that Bristol folder with the BUS notes she marked up, so I'll bring it.
Mijito, your mom asked if you can read this letter from the school office for me. I understand half but the long parts no.
Send me the photo, tia. I can tell you what they want before dinner.
Jose, mi amiga Ana tiene una panaderia en Pawtucket. Dice que nadie encuentra su pagina de Facebook y las fotos salen todas oscuras.
Tell her to send me the login and 4 good pastry photos. I still have the checklist I used for the Broad St shops.
Gracias. Your dad used to say you learned those office words so fast after kindergarten.
Kitchen words with you all, paperwork words outside. I still translate both ways.
Ay gracias. Ella se pone nerviosa con ingles. Tambien quiere un papelito para poner cerca de la caja.
I can make it bilingual in Canva and keep the words simple. Same style as the barber and mini market ones.
Mijo, I sent you the voice note. Tell Maria I put extra comino in the seco, she will say I am bossy again.
I heard it. Ma laughed already. Are Dani and Meli still coming from Providence Sunday?
Dani yes, Meli maybe after work. The Pawtucket boys said they can bring bread if you remind them.
I'll message them. And I'll call you after dinner so you can tell me the part I missed.
You left the blue recycling bin full again. I moved it by the back door before work.
I got it tonight. Can you tell Maria I already bought coffee filters?
Fine, but you still owe me $38 for gas and the Wi-Fi split. Send it before Carlos comes by later.
Sending after my bank clears. I'll grab the bin and wipe the stove too.
Send me the little job grid before you stare at it until midnight.
I added take-home and drive time. The Attleboro one wins on minutes but not by much.
Add the shift times too. You always forget the part where closing at 9 ruins dinner.
Yeah. Seeing it lined up stopped the spinning, at least.
After Saturday match, your place still doing food or are we just grabbing pizza?
You still want the Foxboro tailgate spot Saturday? I can bring the small grill if you bring that navy scarf.
Come by. Ma already said she wants the big pot going, chicken with aji on the side.
Yeah, scarf is already in the car. I also grabbed the Fenway ticket alert you sent for later this month.
Good. March is going to wreck your wallet between Route 1 parking and Lansdowne snacks.
Say less. That green sauce from last time was serious. I’ll bring drinks.
Worth it if both home crowds finally give me something to yell about.
Bring ice too. If my cousins hear there’s food after the game, the kitchen gets packed fast.
Mijo, cuando salgas trae la carpeta azul. La que tiene los papeles viejos de Providence.
La vi arriba del closet, junto con mis cosas de la escuela de North Attleboro.
Si, esa. No mezcles los papeles de Rhode Island con los de las escuelas, despues no encontramos nada.
Ok, la dejo en la mesa antes de ir a Market Basket.
Jose, encontre una caja tuya en el closet. Tiene fotos con uniforme rojo y blanco y esos zapatos viejos con tierra todavia.
Leave it by the stairs. I think those are from the Mason Field days.
Tambien hay un papel de la cena de la clase, con el cohete dibujado. Lo guardo?
Yeah keep that one. I might need the date from it.
Jose, pon el canal 41 cuando llegues. Quiero oir lo de Quito antes de empezar el arroz.
Ya voy. Dejaste el sofrito afuera or should I chop more cebolla?
Cebolla no. Cilantro si. Y llama a Lucia suavecito, vino seria del trabajo.
Ok, I’ll sit with you for the 6:30 and then get her.
Mijo, la senora de la panaderia en Pawtucket quiere saber si todavia puedes revisar su formulario para el puesto del sabado.
Si, mandame foto. Tambien llevo las hojas en espanol para los negocios de la Broad St.
Gracias. Ella dice que muchos no entienden lo del permiso nuevo y se asustan con tanta carta en ingles.
Por eso voy. Si puedo dejarles el numero correcto y explicar despacio, ya ayuda.
Mijo, encontré otra foto vieja. Tu mami está jovencita en la plaza, creo que esa fue antes del viaje a Quito.
Mijo, la senora de Providence me pregunto otra vez si tu puedes explicarle el papel del food cart. Dice que en la oficina le hablaron muy rapido.
Mijo, can you fix this note for the Pawtucket office? I know what it says but the English sounds cold.
Mándamela cuando puedas. Estoy armando una carpeta con las de Quito y las de Bogotá para no perderlas.
Send it. I can make it sound normal, not like a machine.
Si, mandame foto del papel. Le puedo escribir los pasos en espanol y marcar donde tiene que llamar.
Mijo, te mando foto de una carta de la escuela de Valeria. Can you tell me what they want before Friday?
Send both pages. I can make it plain for Tia Nora after dinner.
You were always good with that. Even at the school nights, the moms would relax after you said it your way.
Tambien quiere poner sus empanadas en Facebook pero no sabe que decir sin gastar mucho.
También tengo una de tu abuelito frente a esa iglesia grande en La Candelaria. Dame chance y la escaneo en la escuela.
That's the kind of thing I want them to see on my resume, not just dates and software.
Que no pague nada todavia. Le hago un texto corto con precios, barrio, horario y una foto clara.
Perfecto. Esa va al lado de la del cuaderno de direcciones de la abuela.
You still read those letters faster than the rest of us. I remember you at the kitchen table with a pencil, so serious.
Back then I kept my voice low. Now I just grab the pen.
Are you driving into Boston or taking the train tonight?
Driving. Westland Ave garage, then over to Symphony Hall by 7:50.
Send me the car mix later. The one with Marc Anthony after that slow old song was good.
I moved it around. Added two quieter tracks for the ride home too.
I looked at that screenshot. If they can't show where people land after the 10 weeks, skip it.
Exactly. I need the page that says helper today, case desk in 6 months, team lead after that. Not a poster with big words.
Also ask if the Spanish calls count as part of the hours, and if the $300 is real or reimbursement later.
Yeah because gas to Pawtucket twice a week plus missing shifts is where it gets tight.
Mijo, if you pass by Attleboro today, can you bring the check for the light bill? I can meet you after 11.
Yeah, I set it aside. I also have that manager calling again before lunch.
The one with the morning hours?
Yes. They sent the numbers in writing, so I want to look once more before I answer.
You leaving again after dinner or actually staying home for once?
Only after I help Ma clean up. The 9:00 set starts near Attleboro.
Wear the shoes you don't slide around in. Last time you came back limping and still smiling.
I packed the good pair and a towel. Back late, don't lock the side door.
You still want me to ask Richie at the rec center after the match tomorrow?
Yeah, ask him what the hours really look like. The posting makes it sound like all desk and no people.
Lol you lasted 20 minutes reading that warehouse listing before your soul left your body.
Exactly. I am trying to be less dumb about what I say yes to this time.
Mijo te mande una foto del papel de la escuela. No entiendo la parte de 'household member'.
I saw it. Put Tia Rosa on the first line, then cousin Luis below. I'll type it cleaner and send you the words.
Gracias. Y tu mama dice que el cajon de la cocina ya no cierra otra vez.
I bought the slides Wednesday. I'll do that one after lunch and send you the sentence before you go to work.
Jose, if you come after lunch, bring the small wrench from your car.
I can swing by around 3:20. Need anything from Home Depot on the way?
Only the faucet washer if they have it. Then we go to Maria's for dinner?
Yes, I'll come get you first.
I moved your blue pouch off the kitchen table before Ma wipes everything down.
Gracias. Leave the little paper with the hostel and bus numbers inside it.
The one with Puerto Natales, Grey, and that 8-day scribble? It looks intense.
Yeah, don't toss it. I added another $30 after groceries.
You bringing the cones or just the excuses today?
Cones, two extra pinnies, and the lineup I made last night. I put myself up top first half.
Lol bold. Also my cousin at the shop said send him your number after the game.
Good. After we win, remind me before everyone runs to get food.
Legs still cooked from yesterday or you good for Sunday?
Good. Did the Bay Path loop early, then kept it easy. Calves are alive.
Lol that muddy stretch builds character. Bring the blue cones for warmups?
Yeah. Also packing the old shoes, the side near the bridge was a mess.
Mijo, para la mesa del sabado, cuantos papeles llevo? Tu mama dice que tienes todo en la computadora.
Lleva 40 hojas. En el archivo puse columnas para nombres, llamadas hechas, y quien prometio venir.
Y los de la iglesia de Pawtucket, los pongo aparte o contigo?
Aparte, por favor. Esta noche voy a probar una forma nueva de copiar esos nombres sin escribirlos dos veces.
I already talked to Marco from the car. Can I show you the job post before dinner?
Send it. And don't make me guess what part you're avoiding.
Screenshot coming. Be direct but don't roast me in front of Ma.
Then come to the hallway, genius.
Mijo, para el sabado necesitas comprar cilantro y achiote. Rosa dijo que tu mesa queda cerca de la musica.
Ok, I can grab both after Market Basket. If my table is by the speakers, tell her I am keeping the bachata playlist for later.
Bueno. Tambien lleva las fichas de domino, tus primos quieren jugar despues de servir.
Perfect. Food first, then dominoes. I told Marco to stop by if the match ends early.
Mijo, bring me the paper tonight. I can read the part with the hours.
Thanks. It says Tuesday and Thursday at the family center, plus two Saturdays at a bakery office.
Good if they pay something. And ask who teaches you after the first job, not only the first week.
That's my question too. I don't want to finish and still be guessing what comes next.
Mijo, dejaste los zapatos en la cocina. Llegaste tarde anoche?
Si, after cleanup. We ran out of chairs and had to make two extra sign-in sheets.
Entonces comieron todos? Te guardé arroz, no compres lunch hoy.
Gracias. I'm still thinking about one dad who stayed after to ask for the Saturday list.
I got the 3 and 3 candles. Do not let Ma buy another pack just because they were on sale.
Tell her I already saw them. Also she wants the school-folder photo printed for the table.
The one where you look terrified in your tiny backpack? Classic. Ma said Abuela laughed because you answered her in kitchen Spanish and the teacher in English.
That photo gets one minute on the table, max.
Mami asked if you need the driveway spot tonight or if you're out.
Home after 10. Save it if Carlos isn't stopping by.
Cool. Also I found that sticky note from Ana about swapping your Friday plans for her double. Want it trashed?
Yeah toss it. We don't need old calendar math in the kitchen drawer.
You good for Sunday? Devin is asking if you can take left side again.
Yeah, tell him I'm in. I'll bring the cones if nobody grabbed them.
Perfect. NAU guys are short two, so don't bail on us.
I won't. Just remind me what color before I leave.
You still coming to indoor after that table thing at St. Mary's?
Yeah, if we finish packing boxes by 5. They need people for intake and Spanish directions.
Of course they put you on talking duty lol. Save legs for Sunday, we need midfield.
I'll be fine. Mostly pointing families to tax help, rent forms, and the small biz table.
You still got those door-hanger files from that city thing? My cousin's auto shop wants something before spring tire season.
Yeah, buried in Drive. I can swap the logo, clean up the map pin, and make a short post for FB/IG.
He said his dad wants the Spanish copy checked too. You know how they get with Google Translate lol.
Send the draft. I’ll make it sound normal and keep the phone number big.
Rosa called early. She says you did not answer her audio from last night.
I saw it late. I'll answer after lunch, promise.
Good. She worries like me. Also ask her if the Providence girls want the green sauce mild.
Mild for them, spicy for the Pawtucket crew. I remember.
Mijo, dejaste el papel de MassHire en la mesa. Lo necesitas hoy?
Si, gracias. Voy a call them after lunch and fix the resume part they marked.
Bueno. No agarres cualquier cosa solo por estar apurado.
I know. I just want something I can keep doing without turning into a zombie.
Jose, la puerta del bano hace ese ruido otra vez. Tambien Rosa pregunto si viste su mensaje.
I'm tightening the hinge after dinner. For Rosa I saved the photo and started a Word draft, just need the date from her.
Ok. No pongas cosas muy largas, ella se confunde.
I know. Two short lines, then I'll mark it done in the family sheet.
Tu primo Diego dice que puede llamarte desde Providence despues de las 8. Le conte que estas entre dos caminos.
Gracias, tia. I want to ask him how he handled taking less money at first.
El siempre habla claro. Tambien dile que tienes esos papeles de Bristol, para que entienda tu plan.
Yeah, I can show him the resume line with the BUS and accounting classes.
Mijo, si vas a Providence esta noche, puedes pasar por Pawtucket primero?
Si, I can stop by around 7:10. I have the 8:30 floor thing on Eddy after.
Perfecto. I made humitas. Don't eat too much if you're going to be spinning for two hours.
Save me two for tomorrow. Tonight I need to move light.
Mijito, mandame foto de como le quedo a Maria el refrito. El mio sale muy aguado.
Todavia esta moviendolo. Puso tomate menos maduro esta vez.
Eso. Y dile que no se olvide el comino, poquito nomas.
Le digo. Estamos en la cocina con las noticias bajito.
Domingo vienes despues del juego? Tu mama quiere comer temprano.
Si, if the Foxboro traffic isn't bad. I want to catch first pitch of the Florida game on the radio too.
Trae el radio pequeno. In the kitchen we can hear both if Lucia lets us.
Deal. I am not missing the 9th inning or the second half this time.
I put the internet due date on the fridge. Please don't Venmo me last minute again 😑
I know. Waiting on one answer Monday. The store one is already a yes if I want it.
The one with dental after 30 days?
That one. But the other work feels more like me, so I'm trying not to answer tired.
Found the old middle school folder. You really wrote Mom's dentist notes in tiny letters like the paper was going to yell at you.
Please throw that folder into the sun.
Nope. Same guy who made Dad's clinic portal behave yesterday. Growth, sir.
The portal was easier than explaining a root canal bill at age 11.
You still going to that info session Monday or did the job search rage win?
Bro you still coming Sunday? Also my cousin asked about that bakery thing. She said you made her uncle less nervous at town hall lol
So which one is winning, numbers guy?
Sunday yes. For your cousin, tell her I can sit with her after the game and go line by line.
Going. The posting actually mentions walk-ins, family questions, and Spanish preferred.
On paper, Mansfield. Better money, weird hours, longer ride.
That's more you than staring at a warehouse scanner all day.
Exactly. I can talk people through a messy room. Teachers used to hand me the mic when parents looked lost.
She has like $80 total for flyers/posts, so don't let her get fancy.
That's enough. One clean flyer, neighborhood groups, and a simple menu photo. No paid stuff unless she sells first.
And off paper?
North Attleboro keeps pulling at me. I can actually see myself there after the first month.
Mijo, para mañana ¿tu mamá va hacer las bolitas de papa con queso o yo llevo una bandeja?
She’s doing them here. I’m on peeling duty after work.
Bueno. Dile que no se olvide el maní, como antes cuando todos llegaban con hambre.
I’ll remind her. She already asked if you’re bringing the shrimp and limes.
Jose, si vas a Providence lunes, puedes pasar por donde tu primo? Queda cerca de la oficina esa.
Si, despues voy para North Attleboro. Mami quiere que revise una caja con report cards viejos.
Ay esos papeles. Tu mama guardo todo desde chiquito, hasta los dibujos de la escuela.
Mijo, dile a Maria que guardé la receta del seco. Lucia me dijo que ustedes pelean por quién lava las ollas 😂
I know. If I find the right envelope, I’ll send you a picture before she reorganizes it again.
Rosa, she exaggerates. I washed them last time, she just hates when I leave them soaking.
Bueno, no hagan ruido cuando Carlos pase mañana. Maria sounded tired on the phone.
I'll keep it calm. He said he's only dropping off the toolbox and staying for coffee.
I passed by the old field this morning. They changed the fence near the left corner.
That corner was always bad. I ate dirt there more than once.
You and those boys after class, always asking me for rides home with muddy socks.
I remember. If you still have the old red jacket, bring it Sunday.
If you disappear next weekend, at least leave Mom the car Saturday morning.
Leaving Friday after dinner, back Sunday night. Orleans if the room is still cheap.
Of course. You and that wind. Bring a real jacket this time.
I know. Same duffel: shell, boots, extra socks, and the towel Mom hates.
You bringing those coffee beans Sunday or did they disappear already?
Still have one bag from Quito and one from Bogotá. I wrote the neighborhoods on them so I don't mix them up.
Of course you labeled coffee like match gear. Bring both. After the game we compare.
Deal. The Bogotá one came from the little shop near the street my mom kept pointing out.
You still doing hill repeats after pickup tomorrow or are your legs cooked?
Doing them. That map with the three towers keeps bullying me from my desk.
Lol fair. Bring the ankle brace then. Also I found used poles for $38 if your little stash can handle it.
Send the link. I wrote March gear cap as $60, so maybe.
You still coming after the Revs game or your house turning into a whole kitchen shift again?
Kitchen shift. My mom said one aunt, now there are cars out front and Dad changed the playlist twice.
Save me whatever comes out of that big pot. Last time the music was louder than the TV.
If you swing by later just text first. Nobody knows how many plates we're at yet.
Mijo, manana pasa por Carlos antes de la comida. He said the bag is too heavy.
I put him after Stop & Shop, about 5:30.
Gracias. Bring him straight here, I start the seco early.
Jose, mandame foto cuando pongas la bandera en la mesa. La senora del grupo de Providence quiere ver si cabe al lado de las empanadas.
Mijo, your mom still has the spice mix for the dark fruit drink? I found the little bread mold in Pawtucket.
I just taped it down. The empanadas fit, and the signup sheet is on the left so people see it before they eat.
Yes, she kept it in the top cabinet. She wants to test a small batch before everyone comes over later this year.
Good. Tell Lucia not to eat the bread faces before the cousins arrive this time.
Gracias, sobrino. Despues no te vayas rapido, hay musica en la plaza y tu mama quiere bailar un ratito.
Too late probably. I will hide a tray and label it for the table.
I blocked the afternoon. Once the table is covered, I am staying.
Mijo, en la escuela pusieron un aviso. Necesitan alguien para coordinar entregas dos tardes. Te mando foto?
Si, mandame. I can clean up the English and put it in my follow-up sheet.
Y tu mama dijo que vengas con hambre manana. Hay seco y arroz.
Perfect. I have soccer early, then I'll pass by Pawtucket before dance.
You left muddy socks by the washer again. I am not touching those.
My bad, I got back late from North Attleboro and tossed the bag there.
Marco texted the house chat looking for his blue bottle. Check your car before Mom blames me.
Found it with Devin's tape. I'll drop both off after lunch.
Mijo, para cocinar hoy pon la musica bonita, no todo tan rapido.
Ya hice una lista: primero los boleros de papi, despues Carlos Vives para levantar un poco.
Bueno. Y esta noche llegas tarde otra vez de Boston?
Si, el programa empieza a las 8. Te dejo el seco calentando antes de salir.
Jose, Sunday I bring the small radio. Your mother wants boleros while cooking, like when you were little.
Good. She also wants you to bring the old passport pouch from Attleboro if you still have it.
I have it. Papers from before you were here, and some photos from Guayaquil.
Bring the photos, not the whole stack. Lucia is already turning the dinner into a museum.
Jose, the store on Route 1 still needs evening people. Your cousin said they start quick.
I know. That check would be easier this month.
Easier is good. But yesterday your mother showed me the photo with all those tables full.
Yeah. Seeing the room like that made it harder to picture leaving after two weeks.
Mijo, tu mami me mando foto de la masa. Dile que no ponga tanto queso esta vez, jajaja.
I’m not telling her that unless you send it in a voice note first.
Ay no, ella manda en esa cocina. Tambien preguntale si despues del canal de la tarde hablamos del domingo de San Jose.
I’ll ask when she’s done watching. She already wrote names for who’s bringing what.
Llegaste tarde hoy? Pase por Attleboro y no estabas.
Si, fui a Boston despues de la llamada con Maya. Ensayaron una app para registrar gente con el telefono.
Eso ayuda para no perder nombres. Manana puedes mirar mi carta antes de cenar?
Claro. Tambien tengo que limpiar las filas duplicadas antes de mandar el conteo de la semana.
I found your stack of flyers on the kitchen chair. Are these for Saturday or can I move them?
Saturday. Please leave them by the door. The restaurant owners asked for the Spanish version plus the QR sheet.
Fine, but label the bags. Mami almost used one for Market Basket.
I'll tape a note. One bag is for volunteers, one is for the shops.
Mijo, send me the English line again for the school paper. The Pawtucket office closes at 4 tomorrow.
Send me the photo here and I'll write it cleaner.
Gracias. You always fix my words. After that I tell you what happened with Luis in Providence, ay Dios.
Okay, I'll listen after I finish dishes. Don't make the voice note 12 minutes this time.
Jose, your mother said you have interview. Need ride after I finish at 2?
I'm good, Pa. It's near the bus line. They asked for examples working with families.
Tell them about the school gym nights. You knew how to talk to both sides.
Yeah, I wrote that down. Better than pretending I only know spreadsheets.
I go Attleboro at 5. Need ride to get part for sink.
I can. I have the church hall people at 6:15, then dance at 7:30.
Bring paper with questions. The man there knows warehouse supervisor.
Already wrote them. Also ask him if Sunday after the game is better for a call.
Sunday dinner at 5. Your mother says bring the folding chairs from the basement.
I'll bring two chairs and the cooler. Just me coming after the game.
Bueno. Last year you missed this one waiting on that late hospital shift.
I remember. This time I can help cook before everyone gets there.
Before you and Maria go, check the cabinet. We already have two bags of rice.
Too late, she already put rice on the list lol. Need tomatoes and limes though.
Fine but don't let her buy the giant pack of chicken again unless you're both cutting it tonight.
That's the plan after dinner. I'll clear the counter.
So did you answer the offer or are we still doing halftime career court tomorrow?
I answered. Went with the community office one, even with the smaller check.
That the one with shop owners and Spanish flyers? Makes sense. You were bored just talking about the store ladder.
Mom, Prof. Alvarez, and Diego all basically asked which one sounded like work I'd still care about in six months.
Mijo, dejaste la libreta y la computadora en la mesa. La comida se enfria.
Ya voy. I was checking the boxes one more time before I call them.
No mires solo el cheque. Mira si vas a volver a casa tranquilo.
That's the part the boxes don't settle. They just make the room quieter.
Mijo, Don Luis pregunto si puedes mirar el Instagram del restaurante. Dice que tu antes hacias esos volantes bonitos para la gente de la calle Broad.
After lunch I can. Ask him for the menu PDF, two good plate photos, and the password if he remembers it.
El no sabe mucho de esas cosas. Mejor llamalo despacio, en espanol.
Ok. I’ll walk him through it and make a simple weekend special post.
Jose, cuando llegues compra leche y arroz. Lucia said no more takeout this week.
Ok, I'll stop on the way. Tell her I paid the gas already, she can check the app.
Gracias. Carlos called, he will bring the small ladder Sunday but he is sleeping in Attleboro tonight.
Good. I'll clear the hallway before he comes over.
Jose, el hijo de Don Luis va a abrir su barberia pequena. Me pregunto si tu puedes mirar los papeles.
Si, Papi. Dile que traiga la carta de la ciudad y cualquier recibo de renta.
No entiende bien la computadora. Y no quiere gastar en anuncios.
Lo vemos despacio. Primero ordenar documentos, despues una pagina sencilla con horario, direccion y fotos.
I found another envelope in Attleboro. Has the hospital stamp from Providence and some old NA soccer forms.
Can you bring it Sunday? Lucia is sorting the boxes by town.
Yes. The soccer form has your old address near Allen Ave.
That’s probably the one Maria was asking about.
Estoy cerca de Attleboro. Necesitas que lleve la parrilla pequena para manana?
Yes please. After we finish the morning table, people are coming to the house. I have chicken marinating already.
Llevo carbon tambien. Pon musica buena, no solo lo nuevo.
Boleros while we cook, salsa once everyone shows up. Deal.
You vanished after warmups. Everything good?
Not really. Can I ring you after the match instead of standing around making jokes?
Yeah. Bench by the far lot after we pack the nets.
Cool. Lucia's going to look at the text later and tell me if it sounds weak.
After the match, can you help my uncle with that city permit letter? He says you explain it without making him feel dumb.
Yeah, bring it to the field. I know that embarrassed look when a kid gets handed the envelope.
You had that look?
Until about freshman year. Then I figured out the paper was not the boss of me.
Jose, compra cilantro y ají si sales temprano. El pollo está descongelando.
Ok Ma. Same smell in the house as Sundays when we were kids.
Sí, pero ahora tú ayudas, no solo esperas con hambre.
Fair. I’ll get extra because Lucia said Carlos might stop by too.
Voy para alla despues de la ferreteria. Your mother needs onions?
Yes, and maybe another bag of rice. Lucia says cousins are texting from Providence now.
Bueno. I bring the small radio too. That old Hector Lavoe CD is in my car.
